resources.string: www.reddit.com (the current official redesign) ships a lot of JavaScript and is the main reason browsing can feel laggy. Old Reddit is the classic, server-rendered page -- the same one Reddit Enhancement Suite was built for -- and is far lighter.
Inspired by Reddit Enhancement Suite\'s feature of the same name: automatically loads the next listing page as you scroll near the bottom, instead of making you tap "next". Old Reddit only.

Redlib instances are run by third parties and are read-only -- your reddit.com login does not carry over and there is no account or voting support. Instances also go up and down; pick another one if your choice stops loading.
